note: Town-run regional park campground 2 km west of Unity off Hwy 14, opposite the 9-hole Unity golf course: a sheltered figure-8 gravel loop of non-electric sites among trees, with a picnic shelter and free firewood. Thinly documented: the town's site describes only the in-town park, so call the town office before relying on it. --Claude
summary: Keep with caveat (weak presence). Only Tourism Saskatchewan's listing describes the campground: 14 non-electric sites, $10/night, modern washroom, free firewood, group camping. Town site says nothing about it. All sites nightly (no seasonal sign). Not waterfront kept, pin fine, phone = town office.
flags: PRESENCE: thin. Tourism Saskatchewan's current listing is the only source describing the campground (14 non-electric sites, '$10' daily). The stored website (town parks page) covers only the in-town regional park and never mentions camping. No booking channel, no season posted. Imagery (Esri z17) shows a maintained figure-8 gravel loop with a service building and no parked rigs. Reviewer may treat it as under-documented (kept with a call-ahead caveat in the note) or drop.
LONG-STAY: nothing seasonal found; all 14 sites appear nightly. Google Maps 4.6 from 14 reviews belongs to the in-town park (ball diamonds/pool), not this campground.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Only a small farm dugout ~130 m south across a gravel road (Esri z17); no lake nearby (stored evidence's 'set back ~300-400m back from the lake' wording is wrong - there is no lake).
PIN: no move; stored 52.44085,-109.19620 sits at the loop's centre junction (Tourism SK 52.440211,-109.195978 agrees).
PHONE: stored 306-228-2621 is the Town of Unity office (town home page, Tourism SK). No change.
